blueprint_tool_entry: observe-langfuse-web-1 (F-a1-05, PASS.md A1) - the trace backend every run already lands in; PASS.md has no Evaluation row in any section, so the store is what this capability binds to today
standard: none adopted; the case-set, replay and verdict shapes are this repository's design (the research records cap-evaluation names are listed under research_ids). The GenAI semantic conventions are named by cap-evaluation only as the carrier a verdict travels on, version unverified, and are used here in adapters/live.py alone
design_notes: Three dimensions are scored (trajectory, tool_use, task_completion). X-cap-evaluation-003 names four; the fourth, multi-turn quality, needs more than one turn and is out of this harness's scope - dropped on purpose and recorded here rather than silently.

cap-evaluation and cap-evaluation-implement both mint E-adapter-otel-trace-scoring-harness and E-swap-candidate-local-fixture-replay-harness as proposed entity ids; neither resolves in kb/entities.jsonl (checked with tools/kb.py show), so neither is cited above as a kb id. The adapter roles they name are what adapters/live.py and adapters/second.py implement.

Extensions to the owner skill's shapes, so a reader can tell them from the skill: the conformance report adds regressed_outcome, regressed_transitions, transitions_named, served_effects, executed_effects, rubric_markers_seen_by_unit, baseline_retained and gate_blocks_zero_case; GateStageResult is implemented exactly as cap-evaluation-implement states it, with evidence_record_id derived from the report id here rather than from an appended evidence store this harness does not own.
The unit under test (unit_under_test.py) is a fixture, not part of the capability: the interface reaches it only inside EvaluationAdapterBase._run_unit, and no adapter imports it.
